title: Outlaws from the West
summary: The gang holes up in Colter. Dutch takes Arthur and Micah out through the snow to search a nearby ranch for food and anything they can use.

objectives.label: Ride with Dutch to look for supplies
Capture the O’Driscoll in the barn
Calm the horse and lead it back

goldRequirements.label: Take no damage during the shootout
Loot 6 or more items from Adler Ranch
Complete with at least 80% accuracy

title: Enter, Pursued by a Memory
summary: Abigail asks Arthur and Javier to find John, who has been missing in the storm. They track him through wolf country and bring him home.

objectives.label: Ride out with Javier to search for John
Follow the trail through the snow

goldRequirements.label: Kill all the wolves without taking any damage
Complete with at least 80% accuracy

title: The Aftermath of Genesis
summary: Pearson needs meat. Charles takes Arthur hunting for deer in the woods above Colter.

objectives.label: Skin the kills and return to camp

goldRequirements.label: Kill each deer with one arrow
Do not spook either deer
Get a clean kill on the second deer

title: Old Friends
summary: Micah has found an O’Driscoll camp. The gang attacks it and captures a young O’Driscoll named Kieran.

objectives.label: Join the assault on the O’Driscoll camp

goldRequirements.label: Catch and hogtie Kieran within 45 seconds
Kill 3 O’Driscolls in the same Dead Eye use
Complete within 15 minutes and 30 seconds
Get 15 headshots
Complete the mission without taking any health items

title: Who the Hell is Leviticus Cornwall?
summary: Dutch wants a real score. The gang hits a Cornwall train in the mountains to steal bonds and cash.

objectives.label: Ride to the trestle with the gang

goldRequirements.label: Save Lenny when he is hanging from the train
After stopping the train, take out the guards within 1 minute and 30 seconds
Take no damage during the shootout
Get 10 headshots
Complete the mission without taking any health items

title: Eastward Bound
summary: The weather breaks. The gang packs up Colter and wagons east to a new camp overlooking the Heartlands.

goldRequirements.label: Pick up Javier when entering Horseshoe Overlook
Complete within 6 minutes

title: Polite Society, Valentine Style
summary: Uncle, Arthur, and the girls ride into Valentine for supplies and gossip. Mary-Beth comes back with a train lead; a man from Blackwater complicates the afternoon.

objectives.label: Deal with the man from Blackwater

goldRequirements.label: Return the lost wagon horse to its owner
Find Karen within 45 seconds

missables.label: Honor choice: return the runaway coach horse
missables.description: Helping the stranded coach driver on the ride into town is an optional Honor opportunity.

title: Americans at Rest
summary: Arthur finds Javier, Charles, and Bill drinking in Valentine. A bar fight with a giant named Tommy spills into the street.

objectives.label: Meet the boys in the Valentine saloon

goldRequirements.label: Save Javier within 15 seconds
Defeat Tommy within 1 minute and 30 seconds

title: Exit Pursued by a Bruised Ego
summary: Hosea takes Arthur to buy a proper horse, then on a bear hunt that goes badly in the woods near the Dakota.

objectives.label: Ride with Hosea to the horse fence
Survive the attack and get back to camp

goldRequirements.label: Track the bear within 1 minute 30 seconds
Shoot the bear at least 6 times
Complete within 12 minutes

title: Paying a Social Call
summary: Kieran is forced to lead Arthur, Bill, and John to Colm’s camp. The raid turns into a night assault on Six Point Cabin.

objectives.label: Ride with Kieran to the O’Driscoll hideout

goldRequirements.label: Silently kill 4 O’Driscolls
Get 12 headshots
Complete with at least 80% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items

title: A Quiet Time
summary: Dutch sends Arthur to take Lenny into Valentine for a drink. The night gets out of hand.

goldRequirements.label: Try to make amends with an old rival
Catch Lenny in the act
Don't get arrested

title: The Spines of America
summary: Hosea introduces Arthur to Seamus, a crooked fence at Emerald Ranch. Together they steal a wagon from Carmody Dell.

goldRequirements.label: Loot everything from Carmody Dell
Don't get spotted
Deliver the wagon to Emerald Ranch within 1 minute and 10 seconds

title: Blessed are the Meek?
summary: Micah is locked in the Strawberry jail. Arthur breaks him out, and the escape turns into a massacre in the streets.

goldRequirements.label: While escaping, kill all mounted lawmen within 55 seconds
Get 15 headshots
Complete with at least 70% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items

missables.label: Micah’s confiscated guns
missables.description: During the breakout Micah can recover guns taken from him in Strawberry.

title: Who is Not Without Sin
summary: Reverend Swanson is in trouble at Flatneck Station. Arthur pulls him out of a poker game, a beating, and a near hanging.

objectives.label: Get him out of the poker game
Stop the fight and the hanging

goldRequirements.label: Win 2 hands of Poker
Return the Reverend to camp within 2 minutes and 5 seconds

title: The First Shall Be Last
summary: Trelawny has a lead on Sean, held by bounty hunters west of Blackwater. Arthur, Javier, and Charles break him out on the Upper Montana.

availability.notes: Sean’s rescue is available in Chapter 2; do not delay indefinitely.

missableWarning: Complete Sean’s rescue during Chapter 2

objectives.label: Scout the bounty hunters with Javier

goldRequirements.label: Silently kill the bounty hunters by the river with Javier
Shoot the rope to free Sean
Get 10 headshots
Complete the mission without taking any health items

title: The Sheep and the Goats
summary: John and Arthur steal a flock of sheep and sell them in Valentine. Cornwall’s men walk in on the payday, and the town becomes a war zone.

goldRequirements.label: Herd all the sheep into the pen in Valentine
Get 25 headshots
Complete with at least 70% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items

title: A Strange Kindness
summary: After Valentine, Dutch wants a new camp. Micah leads Arthur to a supposed site that turns into a hostage rescue in the woods.

objectives.label: Return the captive to his family

goldRequirements.label: Return the captive to his family within 1 minute and 40 seconds

Complete the mission without taking any health items

summary: Arthur delivers the stolen oil wagon to the hide site for the train job.

summary: Arthur, John, Sean, and Charles stop the train with the oil wagon and rob it before the law closes in.

title: A Fisher of Men
summary: Abigail asks Arthur to take Jack fishing. Pinkertons interrupt the afternoon on the riverbank.

goldRequirements.label: After arriving at the river, catch a fish within 1 minute and 30 seconds

missables.label: Jack’s comic book request
missables.description: Jack’s penny dreadful request can trigger during this outing.
